evidence.quoted_text: const known = observation?.usage !== undefined && usage !== undefined;
evidence.reason: The pinned code still computes `known` from usage-counter presence only, with no per-leg unmeasured/`usageProvenance` guard. A leg containing an unmeasured dispatch can therefore contribute defined (including zero) counters to the subtotal, be normalized as measured, inflate `knownCount`, and release reservation/admission as if spend were known. This is an ordinary token-accounting correctness defect under the current contract’s source-of-truth token requirement, not a request for new scope; the proposed per-leg flag is the minimal fix.
